main.description: Public ATM creator membership program. This is the app-neutral membership identity that apps can honor for cross-app access; prices live in money.atmosphere.price and app-specific presentation lives in sidecar records.

description.description: Public description or terms for the membership program. Do not include private delivery instructions, member lists, customer emails, or processor state.

scope.description: Whether apps should treat this as a creator-wide membership or a membership intended for one app surface. Absence should be treated as creator-wide.

product.description: Optional parent money.atmosphere.product record with kind=membership.

archived.description: Whether this membership program is no longer offered to new members. Missing means false.

sourceGeneration.description: Optional app-owned monotonic projection generation used to reject stale membership projections.

createdAt.description: When this membership program record was created.

updatedAt.description: When this membership program record was last updated.
